notes: Authoritative body roster and deployment state for the body.html Learning Journey panel. Source of truth: oscen/neuromorphic/src/neuromorphic/models/registry.py (bodies) and oscen/deploy/docker-compose.*.yml (deployments). Keep in sync when bodies are added or specialist brains move between stages.

bodies.name: pendulum
bodies.label: Inverted Pendulum
bodies.description: 1-DOF inverted pendulum. Simplest motor control task. Teaches the brain to learn active angle control via STDP and eligibility traces without passive joint stiffness.

bodies.name: arm_2dof
bodies.label: 2-DOF Planar Arm
bodies.description: 2-DOF fixed-base arm. Teaches reach-to-target coordination on the manipulation channel. Fall mode is none (the body cannot fall).

bodies.name: walker_4dof
bodies.label: 4-DOF Biped Walker
bodies.description: Minimal biped walker. Gait learning with a central pattern generator and honest forward-distance reward. Used by the 1M production brain and the locomotion / balance specialists.

bodies.name: speech_only
bodies.label: Speech-Only Brain
bodies.description: No physics body. Motor cortex trains speech and prosody via STDP on a dedicated sub-range. Used by the 100K audio specialist for the speech curriculum (babbling -> first words -> tokens -> repeat -> association -> ...).

bodies.name: humanoid_29dof
bodies.label: 29-DOF Humanoid
bodies.description: Full Optimus / G1 / Atlas class humanoid. 29 actuated joints across locomotion (15), manipulation (12), and head (2) channels. Unlocks coordinated whole-body skills once the walker brain masters walk and the manip specialist reaches stable reach-and-hold.

specialist_brains_unimplemented.label: 100K Head Control
specialist_brains_unimplemented.blocker: no head_only body manifest in registry.py; overlay currently inherits walker_4dof

specialist_brains_unimplemented.label: 100K Visual Learning
specialist_brains_unimplemented.blocker: no sensory-only body manifest; overlay currently inherits walker_4dof

specialist_brains_unimplemented.label: 100K Language / LLM
specialist_brains_unimplemented.blocker: no language-only body manifest; overlay currently inherits walker_4dof
